traceability.notes: All functional requirements and acceptance criteria from docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md are implemented and verified by passing tests. The require-branch-annotation rule enforces @story/@req on significant branch types, supports configurable scope with validation and clear config error messages, handles nested structures, associates comments with branches correctly (including special handling for SwitchCase), and includes performance tests and user-facing documentation with examples. The rule is integrated into the plugin’s recommended/strict presets. Therefore this story is fully implemented.
